why: owner 27 Nov: 1.2.2 draft, buffs reach the report

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.2.2-beta (draft) for WoW Forever 1.60.1 (game build 71139)

Fixed
- Buffs and debuffs that never reached the report: a short description nobody translated (Stunned, Rooted, Silenced...) was hidden by a 12 letter limit, and a buff tooltip that came through another game function was never seen. Now every buff tooltip is checked, also by its owner frame (Buff, Debuff, Aura, TempEnchant).

Changed
- The game windows switch is OFF by default.

New
- Floating report icon (blinking green frame, counter, click to copy and send the report at wowfarsi.ir/report, right click menu, one-time intro, switch on top of Settings > Status and report).
- Might of Stormwind, Spirit, Well Fed descriptions, Spell ID line, 'You are no longer rested.' and the buff time left in Persian.
- Auction house has its own switch and no English flash on click.

This build is for testing in game. Nothing of the game is written, and nothing runs in combat.
